title: 1. Open campaign analytics
subtitle: Broadcasts → View Analytics
narration: To see how a campaign performed, go to the Broadcasts page, find the campaign, and click View Analytics. Eazybe opens the full report for that broadcast.

title: 2. Read the campaign summary
subtitle: WABA number · Sent on · Total contact · Total credit used
narration: At the top, you'll find the broadcast name and status, the WhatsApp number it was sent from, the date it went out, the total contacts, and the total credit used — plus the broadcast source and a preview of the exact message sent.

title: 3. Filter the delivery activity
subtitle: Total · Sent · Delivered · Read · Failed
narration: In Delivery activity, switch between Total, Sent, Delivered, Read, and Failed. Each row shows the contact, the message time, and its latest status.

title: 4. Check why messages failed
subtitle: Failed tab · reason from Meta
narration: Open the Failed tab to see which messages didn't get through. Each row shows the failure reason exactly as Meta reports it — for example, this message was not delivered to maintain healthy ecosystem engagement.

title: 5. Search or export
subtitle: Search contacts · Export
narration: Use Search contacts to look up a single phone number, or click Export to download whichever delivery group is currently open — Total, or just the failed contacts to fix and retry.

title: 6. Browse and go back
subtitle: 10 / 25 / 50 per page · Back to broadcasts
narration: Choose 10, 25, or 50 rows per page to move through recipients, then click Back to broadcasts when you're done — and that's your campaign performance, end to end.
